testcase.name: Home adapter uses canonical envelope/auth headers, GET-only no-store, encoded filters and opaque target
canonical 401 expiry is preserved and an aborted old response cannot expire a new session
bursts coalesce while pending and never exceed one read/second
scope generation clears protected state and ignores late old reads without overlap
401 clears visible and paused data and blocks refresh until a new identity
403 clears visible and paused data and blocks refresh until a new identity
partial failure retains only same-scope stale block, never successful empty or stale forbidden data
visual pause keeps published identity and accepts newest snapshot only when applied
pagination deduplicates immutable IDs; conflict resets via coherent overview instead of replaying cursor
fallback and source TTL refresh independently of live stream; hidden events reduce work then wake
reconnect/gap invalidate, unrelated events do not, and disposal removes timers
wrong-server response is not admitted into the current cache
Attention pagination reuses canonical category/state/seen cursor contract, not Home display-state
external generations remain distinct during paginated append and never change native results
invalidation matrix and scope keys distinguish external, attention, origin and identity
time spent reading does not extend source TTL by another full interval
business feed pages use actual id/kind/agent_id projection and retain distinct records
overview refresh retains loaded feed as stale then revalidates first page without old cursor
modal pause retains expanded pages only for same revision, resets changed revisions, and never crosses scope
opaque IDs roundtrip canonically without title/path/content and without delimiter aliases
resolver rejects mismatched workspace/server before request and changed result afterward
canonical inspector requires resolved actor and never guesses latest or turns external into execution
claim, native acceptance, execution and unknown remain distinct
result success keeps independent cleanup and verification; keys ignore titles
external activity is always reported and stale working never becomes native running
business feed templates hide tokens/heartbeat and retain decision/failure distinctions
